summary: The audit checks 45 units from Biology courses numbered 100 and above, the approved out-of-department electives (PATH 151 counts only with PATH 151A-D, and BIOE 450 only once), research, teaching and foundational breadth, with a B- or better in every course. At least 23 units must be in courses designated for graduate students, at most 18 units may be research, directed reading and teaching, and courses below the 100 level do not count. You check by hand the advisor-signed program proposal, the 3.0 GPA, at most six units taken CR/NC (S/NC is not limited), and up to nine petitioned units of other Stanford coursework, which you move in.

IzP4Dt6G.why: "Department of Biology and/or Hopkins Marine Station course work, approved out-of-department electives, and foundational breadth courses totaling at least 45 units at or above the 100-level ... These 45 units can be chosen among offerings in the Department of Biology (BIO), the list of approved out-of-department electives (outlined below), research, teaching, and/or foundational breadth courses." "A maximum of 18 units may be a combination of Biology research, directed reading, and/or teaching" (the research, reading and teaching courses the Bulletin lists under BIO Courses). "At least 23 of the 45 units must be courses designated primarily for graduate students" is encoded as at most 22 units from courses not listed as graduate courses. Hopkins courses not cross-listed in BIO, and the up to nine units of "Other Stanford coursework ... Using the General Petition form", are moved in by hand. The Genetics list ends with one option, "PATH 151 AND PATH 151B AND PATH 151A AND PATH 151C AND PATH 151D", which counts only as the full set. "BIOE 450 (same as CHEMENG 450) may only count toward the Biology requirements once."
